## Source inspected
The landing page and Module 1 / Module 2 / executive-summary PDFs were read. This is current program guidance, not a 1990s design file.

## Annotation

The workbook explains eligibility, two “Phases” (self-managing employer vs Client Support Group / representative), and how to apply. It describes CSIL as a self-directed option for home-support clients with high-intensity care needs. The inspected modules do **not** give a 1993 or 1994 founding year.

The landing page is a current SCI BC resource. The Module 1 title block still names BC Paraplegic Association, which the [SCI BC history page](sci-bc-history.qmd) says became SCI BC in 2012. First publication year of the workbook was not printed on the pages inspected.

The provincial CSIL page points readers to this workbook.

## Open questions

- First edition date and whether a ministry-issued predecessor existed in the 1990s.
- How the Law Foundation-funded revision differs from the BCPA original.
